import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Calculate total spending and age
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education Level
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
education_order = ['Basic', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD']
for edu in education_order:
    if edu in df['Education'].values:
        subset = df[df['Education'] == edu]
        ax1.scatter(subset['Income'], subset['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.5, label=edu, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Spending Distribution by Product Category
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = [df[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(labels))
ax2.pie(spending_totals, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Total Spending Distribution by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Customer Age Distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
ax3.hist(df['Age'].dropna(), bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.axvline(df['Age'].median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {df["Age"].median():.0f}')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Purchase Channel Preferences
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_means = [df[ch].mean() for ch in channels]
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
bars = ax4.bar(channel_labels, channel_means, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A'], 
               edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Purchases by Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 5. Family Composition Impact on Spending
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
family_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean().reset_index()
ax5.plot(family_spending['TotalKids'], family_spending['TotalSpending'], 
         marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='darkgreen')
ax5.set_xlabel('Number of Children at Home', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Impact of Family Size on Spending', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_xticks(range(int(family_spending['TotalKids'].max()) + 1))

# 6. Campaign Acceptance Rates
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [(df[camp].sum() / len(df)) * 100 for camp in campaigns]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp 1', 'Cmp 2', 'Cmp 3', 'Cmp 4', 'Cmp 5', 'Last Cmp']
colors_cmp = sns.color_palette('husl', len(campaign_labels))
bars = ax6.barh(campaign_labels, acceptance_rates, color=colors_cmp, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Marketing Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax6.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2., 
             f'{width:.1f}%', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
